opentargets.name: prostate cancer
opentargets.description: A primary or metastatic malignant tumor involving the prostate gland. The vast majority are carcinomas.

opentargets.name: prostate carcinoma
opentargets.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the prostate gland.

opentargets.name: prostate cancer, hereditary, 2
opentargets.description: Any familial prostate cancer in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ELAC2 gene.

opentargets.name: Familial prostate cancer
opentargets.description: Prostate carcinoma that has developed in relatives of patients with a history of prostate carcinoma.

opentargets.name: prostate cancer, hereditary
opentargets.description: An instance of prostate cancer that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual. Familial prostate cancer (FPC) is a malignant tumor of the prostate with an early onset. FPC is either asymptomatic or causes mictionary symptoms, erectile dysfunction, bone pain, venous compression and infectious or inflammatory syndrome (for the metastatic forms). It is also characterized by familial antecedents.
